extracted.name: Easy Tasty Ham Steaks with Maple Glaze for Two
extracted.description: Maple-glazed ham steaks bake in a sweet sauce with plenty of cloves. Serve Easter dinner any night of the week.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Arrange ham steaks in a baking dish.
Whisk brown sugar, maple syrup, Dijon mustard, and vinegar in a bowl; pour over ham steaks. Sprinkle cloves over ham steaks.
Bake in the preheated oven until browned on both sides, about 45 minutes, turning every 15 minutes. Discard cloves before serving.
